findings.text: explicit_unknown is copied from the case name rather than measured - the producing harness sets it as case == "no-window" - so this field would read true even had the annotation failed to render, and the claim a reader takes from it is backed only by the separate rendered.annotation_unknown signal beside it.

the projected exhaustion is carried only in the projection mark's title attribute, so no capture shows that stamp as legible text; the index's projected_exhaustion_at is corroborated by the mark's x-offset (16.16% predicted against 245.5px on a 1305px box, within a pixel) but a reader of the PNG alone cannot read the date, which is the one figure of the three the entry does not legibly show.
